key_value_text.value: 17 e+e-e+e-, 24 e+e-mu+mu- and 1 mu+mu-mu+mu- events with pair masses above 1 GeV/c^2 for 291 pb^-1

name: Test of QED to fourth order by study of four-lepton final states in e+e- interactions at 29 GeV with the HRS detector

summary.plain: The HRS experiment at PEP counted events with four charged leptons in electron-positron collisions at 29 GeV and compared them with the full fourth-order QED calculation, which agreed reasonably well with the data.
summary.technical: HRS: e⁺e⁻ → four-lepton final states at √s = 29 GeV, 17 e⁺e⁻e⁺e⁻, 24 e⁺e⁻μ⁺μ⁻ and 1 μ⁺μ⁻μ⁺μ⁻ events with pair masses above 1 GeV/c², integrated luminosity 291 pb⁻¹; the complete α⁴ QED calculation agrees reasonably well with the data (Phys. Rev. D 42, 2180, 1 October 1990).

title: Test of QED to fourth order by study of four-lepton final states in e+e- interactions at 29 GeV with the HRS detector
why_it_matters: The abstract presents it as a test of QED to fourth order in the coupling constant.
